title: Who helps and who pays
source:
flowchart TB subgraph Service["Service relationships"] direction TB Owner["Asset owner
or representative"] -->|"Records and request"| Objais["Objais"] Acquisition["Acquisition partner"] -->|"Introduces owners"| Objais Objais -->|"Enquiry"| Partner["Insurer or broker partner"] Objais -.->|"Optional introduction"| Expert["Independent service provider"] end subgraph Economics["Fees and costs"] direction TB FeePartner["Insurer or broker partner"] -->|"Fee if earned"| Fees["Objais"] FeeOwner["Asset owner"] -.->|"Optional service fee"| Fees FeeExpert["Service provider"] -.->|"Referral fee if earned"| Fees Fees -->|"Software and data cost"| Supplier["Technology supplier"] Fees -->|"Acquisition cost if incurred"| CostPartner["Acquisition partner"] end Service ~~~ Economics classDef platform fill:#173247,color:#fff,stroke:#173247; classDef party fill:#eaf3f5,color:#173247,stroke:#007d89; class Objais,Fees platform; class Owner,Partner,Acquisition,Supplier,Expert,FeePartner,FeeOwner,FeeExpert,CostPartner party;
caption: The top half shows the service; the bottom half shows the money. The same people appear in both. Dashed lines show possible arrangements, and a fee owed may arrive later. Actual partners and payment terms still need confirmation.

title: From an enquiry to an earned fee
source:
flowchart TB Use["Owner uses the service"] --> Record["Record or estimate updated
Usage cost; no automatic fee"] Record -->|"Owner requests insurance"| Request["Qualified enquiry submitted"] Record -->|"No request"| Continue["Continue or leave
No insurance fee"] Request --> Agreement{"Which event does
the agreement pay for?"} Agreement --> Lead["Partner accepts a payable lead"] Agreement --> Bind["Policy bound under
a commission arrangement"] Agreement --> Unpaid["Rejected, pending or not payable
No earned fee yet"] Lead --> Earn["Unique event earns its agreed fee"] Bind --> Earn Earn --> Invoice["Invoice or payment statement
Same earned fee"] Invoice --> Receipt["Cash received later
Same fee collected"]
caption: The agreement decides whether the fee is earned when a lead is accepted or cover starts. Both payments belong together only with separate contractual rights. Invoicing and collection follow the fee already earned.

title: A customer can return without starting over
source:
flowchart TB New["New owner
Acquisition charged once"] --> E["E: active unpaid opportunity"] DE["D_E: dormant unpaid"] -->|"Returns; reactivation cost"| E DM["D_M: dormant after payment"] -->|"Returns without new eligibility"| M["M: active completed opportunity"] DM -.->|"Return with genuine new eligibility"| E E --> Gate{"Need, request and acceptance;
history permits payment?"} Gate -->|"Paid event within capacity"| M Gate -->|"No payment; continues"| EN["E next month"] M -->|"Continues; no new eligibility"| MN["M next month"] M -.->|"Genuine new eligibility"| EN E -->|"Becomes dormant"| DEN["D_E next month"] M -->|"Becomes dormant"| DMN["D_M next month"] E -->|"Leaves permanently"| X["X: permanent exit"] M -->|"Leaves permanently"| X DE -->|"Leaves permanently"| X DM -->|"Leaves permanently"| X classDef active fill:#eaf3f5,color:#173247,stroke:#007d89; classDef sleeping fill:#fff4df,color:#173247,stroke:#b88b67; class New,E,M,EN,MN active; class DE,DM,DEN,DMN sleeping;
caption: Someone can go quiet and return with the same customer record and payment history. The dashed paths need a genuinely new payable opportunity; returning does not clear payment limits. Insurance cover and software billing can continue separately.

title: Three relationships that can last different lengths of time
source:
flowchart TB
    subgraph Opportunity["Opportunity relationship"]
      direction LR
      E["Eligible opportunity"] -->|"First paid event"| M["Completed opportunity"]
      M -->|"Continued app relationship alone"| M
    end
    subgraph Software["Optional paid software"]
      direction LR
      Start["Owner starts paying"] --> Bill["Billed month"]
      Bill -->|"Billed continuation and next month"| Bill
      Bill -->|"Billing stops"| Stop["No further software fee"]
    end
    subgraph Insurance["Insurance policy"]
      direction LR
      Bind["Policy bound"] --> Active["Policy remains in force"]
      Active -->|"Survives to renewal date"| Renew["Renewed policy term"]
      Renew --> Active
      Renew -.->|"Only with renewal payment rights"| Fee["Earned renewal fee"]
    end
    Opportunity ~~~ Software
    Software ~~~ Insurance
caption: The same person can have all three relationships. One may end while another continues. Software billing and policy renewal do not require a monthly app visit.

title: Earning the fee and receiving the money
caption: A fee can be earned before it is paid. That difference matters when bills are due in the meantime. Receiving the money settles what was owed; it does not earn another fee.

title: The same questions for existing and future offers
caption: Whatever the asset, the business still needs a payer, a reason for payment and costs it can cover. A new category changes those assumptions; it does not guarantee a better result.
